title: EDM and dubstep kit
description: Shared EDM foundations (edm-core: sidechain and pump moves, risers, white-noise builds, impacts, sweeps, reverse swells, snare-roll and filter-build grammars, OTT-style and band-split bus moves, song-form gates for a 104-bar build/drop map) and dubstep (UKF halftime, melodic dubstep, riddim, brostep: sub, reese, growl/formant/FM layers, screech and laser leads, supersaw chords, plucks, vowel chops, four feel templates). All synthesis, no samples; generated by tools/concepts/build.mjs (docs/CONVENTIONS.md, docs/EDM_REFERENCES.md).

ingredients.title: EDM foundation racks
ingredients.description: Chain-only hook defs: edmKick, subSine, edmClap, snareTight, hatClosed, hatOpen, shaker, crash, noiseRiser, hpBuild, pitchRiser, downSweep, reverseSwell, impactBoom, subDrop, superChord, edmPluck, edmPad, sidechain, ducked, lfoPump, ott, drive, wobble, filterBuild, thinBuild

ingredients.title: Dubstep racks
ingredients.description: Chain-only hook defs: dsKick, dsSnare, reeseBass, growlBass, wobbleBass, talkBass, riddimBass, screechLead, laserZap, ukfChord, ukfPluck, ukfArp, ukfLead, atmosPad, vowelChop

ingredients.title: EDM foundation atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/edm foundation atoms (ec.): four-on-the-floor and off-beat patterns, snare rolls (roll4, roll8 + velocity ramps), filter builds (open8, thin8), gap masks, riser gates (rise4, rise8, rise16, hit), the 104-bar form as gates (intro .. outro, drops, notDrops, gap, fillBars) and as masks (mIntro .. mOutro).

ingredients.title: Dubstep atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/edm dubstep atoms (ds.): half-time, brostep and riddim drum patterns, hat accents, sub / growl / wobble / reese / riddim / talk bass lines, wobble rates, the Cm7 Abmaj7 Ebmaj7 Bb7 loop with arp, pluck, lead, chop, screech and laser lines; call / response and 4th-bar fill masks.

ingredients.title: Feel: Half-time dubstep
ingredients.description: Feel template "Half-time dubstep" (138-142 bpm (half-time)): kick on the 1 and the and of 3, the snare alone on beat 3, 8th hats in the standard meter, a held sub and a dark pad. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: UKF melodic dubstep
ingredients.description: Feel template "UKF melodic dubstep" (140-150 bpm (half-time)): half-time drums, wide supersaw chords, a melodic lead and a clean sub: emotion over weight. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Riddim
ingredients.description: Feel template "Riddim" (140-150 bpm (half-time)): sparse drums, a hollow repetitive bass in 3+3+2 with the gaps as the groove, one laser per bar, no chords. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Brostep
ingredients.description: Feel template "Brostep" (140-150 bpm (half-time)): busier kicks, 16th hats, an FM formant growl with screech answers in its gaps. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

feel.title: Feel
feel.description: groove and attitude: boom-bap, trap, hyphy, cloud, lazy
